title: Benchmarking Jailbreak Defenses Against MLCommons Attack Taxonomy: What Survives Adaptive Evaluation?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: a taxonomy-defense coverage matrix reveals systematic blind spots and guides prioritization of future defense research. Directly useful for the safety community to allocate research effort.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses existing defense implementations and AISafetyLab attacks. Setting up 4-6 defenses and mapping to taxonomy categories requires organizational skill. Running all combinations is logistically complex but not technically difficult.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 4-6 defenses x multiple taxonomy categories = large combinatorial experiment. Running all combinations and producing a coverage matrix is a substantial effort. Exceeds 30 hours unless severely reduced (2 defenses, 3 categories).

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
